caption: The drawing depicts a large, ornate ceramic jug with a wide spout and an elaborate handle shaped like an animal, possibly a snake or a swan, with the handle’s head curving over the top edge. The jug is predominantly brown with lighter and darker shading to suggest a three-dimensional appearance. The upper section of the jug is decorated with a band of grape vines, including grape clusters and leaves in relief, which circle the rim. The body of the jug features a detailed scene in relief showing several deer running among trees and vegetation, covering much of the surface. The lower part near the base is slightly lighter in color, and the background of the drawing is a plain off-white or beige, with no additional objects or patterns present.
title: Pitcher w/ Hound Handle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
